description: Block B2 — fill experiment with biologically-valid tasks: one CPU-heavy agent (gsea_permutation, 314s execute, 87.3% baseline bubble) + one mixed agent (gillespie_microbiome, 111s execute, 44% baseline bubble). Agent 1 staggered by 60s so its generate phases overlap gsea's long CPU execute window. Gillespie replaces deseq from B1: it is fixed-compute (25 simulations, ~111s deterministic execute) so completion token variance does not affect execute duration. Expected: gsea bubble drops further than B1 (80.5%); gillespie TPOT stays near baseline (~17.9ms); fill_fraction high; gpu_collision_s low because gillespie execute doesn't overlap gsea execute (gsea finishes first).
